edges.reason: _msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender address.
transfer uses msg.sender as the implicit sender of funds.
transfer forwards the value returned by _msgSender.
transfer delegates its logic to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates its logic to _transfer.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
approve writes the allowance mapping.

amount parameter flows from transfer into _transfer.

amount parameter of transferFrom feeds allowance check and _transfer.

blacklist mapping is checked in _transfer.
